claims.claim_text: Astera's revenue is highly concentrated: top three end customers were ~89% of revenue in 2022 and ~70% in 2023; one end customer was a majority of 2022 revenue; largest distributor was 82% (2022) and 37% (2023) of revenue.
claims.subject: Astera Labs
claims.source_quote: We recognized ... an aggregate of approximately 89% of our revenue from our top three end customers for the year ended December 31, 2022. In 2022, a majority of our revenue was derived from one end customer. ... our largest distributor which accounted for approximately 82% and 37% of our revenue, respectively, for the years ended December 31, 2022 and 2023. ... in 2023, our top three end customers represented an aggregate of approximately 70% of our revenue.
